---
title: "Species PBF Report"
output: word_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)
library(officer)
library(ftExtra)

# 0. load in PBF data
#PBFs <- read.csv("data/PBFs for Shiny app test.csv")
PBFs <- read.csv("C:/Users/elizabeth.keller/Documents/GitHub/PBF-Shiny-app/data/All PBFs - Stressor Categories.csv") # updated file

# data wrangling to make it the right format
# creates species+ESU/DPS; no separator if no ESU/DPS
PBFs$Species_full <- ifelse(
  is.na(PBFs$ESU_DPS) | PBFs$ESU_DPS == "",
  PBFs$Species,
  paste0(PBFs$Species, " – ", PBFs$ESU_DPS)
)
# Sort the PBFs data frame alphabetically by Species_full
PBFs <- PBFs[order(PBFs$Species_full), ]
# Define your species list
selected_species <- c("Atlantic Salmon – Gulf of Maine DPS",
                      "Atlantic Sturgeon – Carolina DPS", 
                      "Atlantic Sturgeon – Chesapeake Bay DPS")

```

## Critical Habitat Table

```{r species-table, echo=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)
library(officer)

# 1. Process data: Manual Bullet + Tab
final_table <- PBFs %>%
  filter(Species_full %in% selected_species) %>%
  group_by(Species_full) %>%
  summarize(
    # \u2022 is the bullet character, \t is the tab
    PBF_manual = paste0("\u2022\t", unique(PBF), collapse = "\n"), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Create Flextable
ft <- flextable(final_table) %>%
  # Fix the layout to the page margins
  set_table_properties(layout = "fixed", width = 1) %>%
  
  # Set column widths
  width(j = 1, width = 2) %>%
  width(j = 2, width = 4.5) %>%
  
  # The "Hanging Indent" fix:
  # This makes the second line of a bullet align with the text, not the bullet.
  style(
    j = "PBF_manual",
    pr_p = fp_par(
      padding.left = 18, # Indent the whole block
      indent = -12       # Pull the first line (the bullet) back to the left
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Labels and style
  set_header_labels(
    Species_full = "Species", 
    PBF_manual = "Physical and Biological Features"
  ) %>%
  theme_vanilla() %>%
  valign(valign = "top", part = "all")

# Display
ft
```
